$comment: Connector registry for tenant ten_vijayawada. Trust tiers map to real institutions,
not to how much we like a feed: statutory = a body with a legal mandate to publish
(IMD, CWC), certified = an accountable operator under a data-sharing agreement
(AP Water Resources Dept SCADA, the state SOC), verified = municipal instrumentation
we own and calibrate, crowdsourced = citizen grievance reports, unknown = the
simulator's own replay channel, which is never allowed to look observed.
Precedence has teeth because the tiers differ: when the Spandana grievance feed and
the WRD SCADA sensor disagree about the Singh Nagar RUB, the certified sensor wins
the projection and the conflict stays visible instead of being averaged away.
Each entry is mirrored by a machine-readable contract at schemas/contracts/<id>.yaml.

connectors.name: India Meteorological Department - Amaravati Met Centre (AWS + DWR)
connectors.owner: India Meteorological Department, Ministry of Earth Sciences
connectors.authority_note: IMD is the statutory forecasting authority for India. Its colour-coded warnings are the legal trigger for district administration action; nothing overrides them.

connectors.name: Central Water Commission - Krishna Basin flood forecasting (Vijayawada site)
connectors.owner: Central Water Commission, Ministry of Jal Shakti
connectors.authority_note: CWC issues the statutory inflow forecast for the Krishna at Prakasam Barrage. Barrage gate operations are justified against this feed, not against ours.

connectors.name: AP Water Resources Dept - Prakasam Barrage & Budameru SCADA
connectors.owner: AP Water Resources Department, Krishna Delta Division (Executive Engineer)
connectors.authority_note: Certified: instruments are calibrated annually by the Division and every reading is attributable to a named Assistant Engineer. Outranks municipal and citizen feeds on any hydraulic subject.

connectors.name: VMC Smart City CCC - traffic counters and adaptive signals
connectors.owner: Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, Smart City Command & Control Centre
connectors.authority_note: Verified: municipal instrumentation we own and calibrate. ANPR plate reads are hashed at the edge and never leave the CCC - the DPIA condition is that only aggregate counts cross this connector.

connectors.name: VMC Smart City LoRaWAN sensor mesh (rain, drain and sump levels)
connectors.owner: Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, Smart City Mission
connectors.authority_note: Verified but cheap: battery-powered LoRaWAN nodes with a known drift and a known habit of transmitting garbage on a failing cell. Quality rules on this connector are deliberately strict and its impossible values are quarantined, not dropped.

connectors.name: Spandana / VMC public grievance and citizen report feed
connectors.owner: Vijayawada Municipal Corporation, Citizen Services (Spandana cell)
connectors.authority_note: Crowdsourced: valuable for coverage where we have no instrument, never authoritative against one. Free text on this connector is UNTRUSTED INPUT - it is stored, displayed and cited as data, and is never interpolated into a prompt as instruction.
connectors.pii_note: Reporter name and mobile are pseudonymised at ingest; only ward and geometry are retained for operations.

connectors.name: AP State Data Centre SOC - OT/SCADA security telemetry
connectors.owner: AP State Data Centre, Security Operations Centre (CERT-In empanelled)
connectors.authority_note: Certified: signed detections from a CERT-In empanelled SOC with a 6-hour statutory incident reporting duty. A detection here can justify a containment recommendation but never an automatic containment action.

connectors.name: Auralis counterfactual replay channel (synthetic)
connectors.authority_note: Everything on this connector is evidence_class='synthetic' and trust_domain='sim'. quality_score is pinned to 0.0 so it can never win a precedence contest, and the ingest path refuses to attach it to an operational incident. It exists so counterfactual output is labelled at the source rather than by convention.
